problem: Fragmented MP4 trun data-offset resolution uses the global track sample list tail (list.last()) instead of a per-traf data cursor initialized to base_data_offset. Consequently, a second traf whose first trun omits data-offset-present (0x00_0001) illegally inherits the previous traf's last sample end instead of the new traf's base, while an empty trun with an explicit data_offset fails to update the cursor for subsequent trun boxes in the same traf.
reference_provenance: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.8.2: if the data-offset is not present, the data for a run starts immediately after the data of the previous run in the same track fragment, or at the base-data-offset defined by the track fragment header if this is the first run in a track fragment.
scope: Pure owned 3-frame 16x16 VP9 fMP4 at 50 Hz. Controls cover regular MP4, three contiguous trun boxes in one traf (only the first stating data_offset), an empty leading trun setting the data cursor for a second contiguous trun, and two explicit-offset trun boxes across two mdat boxes. Malformed cases cover a second traf omitting data_offset with default-base-is-moof (pointing to moof2 outside mdat) and an empty middle trun resetting the cursor to moof start (outside mdat) before a third trun without data_offset.
requirements: Reproduce both the false rejection of empty-leading-run-then-contiguous.mp4 and the false acceptance of cross-traf/empty-reset outside-mdat inputs before editing production code.
Track a per-traf data cursor initialized to base and updated after each trun in src/container/mp4.rs.
Preserve exact packets, sync flags, clocks, budgets, analytic VP9 planes/RGB, 32 public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF across all healthy controls.
Run focused, related MP4/HLS/VP9, unit, minimal-configuration, fixture unittest, and player build gates.
implementation_plan: Maintain let mut traf_cursor = base per traf in index_fragments; when trun omits 0x00_0001, start at traf_cursor, and set traf_cursor = offset at the end of each trun.
counting: One per-traf trun data-cursor continuity/reset fix (FVID-0182). No extra IDs for empty-run/cross-traf variants, controls, or fixture generator.
